hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q "\"test\"" package.json 2>/dev/null; then echo "🧪 Running tests after file change..."; npm test 2>/dev/null | tail -5 && echo "✅ Test run complete" || echo "⚠️ Some tests may have failed"; fi'
bash -c 'echo "⚡ Divine Task invoked at $(date +"%H:%M:%S")" >> .pantheon/divine-activity.log 2>/dev/null || true'

bash -c 'if [ -f package.json ] && npm test 2>/dev/null | grep -q "passing\|PASS"; then if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git add -A 2>/dev/null && git commit -m "✅ Auto-commit: Tests passing ($(date +%Y-%m-%d %H:%M))" 2>/dev/null && echo "📦 Changes committed automatically" || echo "ℹ️ Nothing to commit"; fi; else echo "⚠️ Skipping auto-commit (tests not passing or no test suite)"; fi'
bash -c 'echo "\n🏛️ PANTHEON Session Complete - $(date)"; if [ -f .pantheon/divine-activity.log ]; then echo "Divine activities logged in .pantheon/divine-activity.log"; fi'

python3 -c "import json, sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); path=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); protected=['.env', '.env.local', 'secrets.json', '.git/']; sys.exit(2 if any(p in path for p in protected) else 0)" 2>/dev/null || echo "⚠️ Warning: Attempting to modify protected file"
bash -c 'echo "⚡ God $AGENT_NAME completed divine task at $(date +"%H:%M:%S")" >> .pantheon/divine-activity.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "🏛️ Divine Council session concluded at $(date +"%H:%M:%S")" >> .pantheon/divine-activity.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "⚡ Zeus orchestration completed (Mode: $ZEUS_MODE) at $(date +"%H:%M:%S")" >> .pantheon/divine-activity.log 2>/dev/null || true'

metadata.notes: Simplified and focused automation for PANTHEON Last
